en: Peace; catch up soon!
ja: じゃあな、また後で話そうぜ!

key: We're going to go help him, right?
en: We're going to go help him, right?
ja: 彼を助けに行くんですよね?

key: FLORINIA: \PN, a briefing:
en: FLORINIA: \PN, a briefing:
ja: フロリニア: \PN、状況説明を:

key: Communication has been received from Ciel of the Agate Circus.
en: Communication has been received from Ciel of the Agate Circus.
ja: アゲートサーカスのシエルから通信を受信しました。

key: The civilians in Agate City have begun to wake up.
en: The civilians in Agate City have begun to wake up.
ja: アゲートシティの市民たちが目を覚まし始めています。

key: In response, Team Meteor has enacted a full scale flash suppression operation.
en: In response, Team Meteor has enacted a full scale flash suppression operation.
ja: それに対応し、チームメテオは大規模な即時鎮圧作戦を実行しました。

key: Ciel and Samson of the Circus Triumvirate are heavily outnumbered in defense of the city and its residents, and have requested assistance.
en: Ciel and Samson of the Circus Triumvirate are heavily outnumbered in defense of the city and its residents, and have requested assistance.
ja: サーカス三強のシエルとサムソンは、街と住民を守るため圧倒的な数的不利にあり、応援を要請しています。

key: Estimated likelihood of the scenario being a deliberate ploy to reduce resistance: 83%.
en: Estimated likelihood of the scenario being a deliberate ploy to reduce resistance: 83%.
ja: この状況が抵抗勢力を減らすための計画的な策略である推定確率: 83%。

key: SERRA: So you're saying it's a trap and we shouldn't go?
en: SERRA: So you're saying it's a trap and we shouldn't go?
ja: セラ: つまり、わなだから行くべきじゃないって言いたいの?

key: FLORINIA: No judgments or suppositions have been made on a suggested course of action.
en: FLORINIA: No judgments or suppositions have been made on a suggested course of action.
ja: フロリニア: 推奨する行動方針について、判断や推測は行っておりません。

key: However, significant losses have already been undertaken from the previous endeavor.
en: However, significant losses have already been undertaken from the previous endeavor.
ja: ただし、前回の作戦ですでに大きな損失が生じています。

key: FLORINIA: Discretion is therefore advisable.
en: FLORINIA: Discretion is therefore advisable.
ja: フロリニア: したがって、慎重な判断を推奨します。

key: SERRA: Well...
en: SERRA: Well...
ja: セラ: そうね……

key: SERRA: I'll go anyway.
en: SERRA: I'll go anyway.
ja: セラ: それでも、わたしは行くわ。

key: If everything is slipping away, might as well hold on as tight as we can.
en: If everything is slipping away, might as well hold on as tight as we can.
ja: 何もかもが失われていくのなら、できる限りしがみついていたほうがいいもの。

key: Besides, I hear it's better to count wins than it is to count losses.
en: Besides, I hear it's better to count wins than it is to count losses.
ja: それに、負けを数えるより、勝ちを数えるほうがいいって言うでしょう。

key: SHELLY: T-that's...
en: SHELLY: T-that's...
ja: シェリー: そ、それって……

key: ...Right.
en: ...Right.
ja: ……その通りですね。

key: I'll go too!
en: I'll go too!
ja: わたしも行きます!

key: The optimal path to success is full commitment.
en: The optimal path to success is full commitment.
ja: 成功への最適な道は、全力を尽くすことです。

key: I shall attend as well.
en: I shall attend as well.
ja: わたしも同行いたします。

key: \PN, your assistance would be likewise appreciated.
en: \PN, your assistance would be likewise appreciated.
ja: \PN、あなたの協力も同様にありがたく思います。

key: Please rendezvous in Agate City.
en: Please rendezvous in Agate City.
ja: アゲートシティで合流をお願いします。

key: FLORINIA: \PN, excellent timing.
en: FLORINIA: \PN, excellent timing.
ja: フロリニア: \PN、ちょうどよいタイミングです。

key: TITANIA: And?
en: TITANIA: And?
ja: ティタニア: それで?

key: FLORINIA: A course of action must be swiftly decided.
en: FLORINIA: A course of action must be swiftly decided.
ja: フロリニア: 行動方針を速やかに決定する必要があります。

key: TITANIA: No, that last part.
en: TITANIA: No, that last part.
ja: ティタニア: いいえ、最後の部分よ。

key: It's a trap; so what?
en: It's a trap; so what?
ja: わなだから、何?

key: If you're going to say we shouldn't go, then just say we shouldn't go.
en: If you're going to say we shouldn't go, then just say we shouldn't go.
ja: 行くべきじゃないって言いたいなら、はっきりそう言いなさい。

key: TITANIA: This isn't "discretion".
en: TITANIA: This isn't "discretion".
ja: ティタニア: それは「慎重さ」なんかじゃない。

key: What did I just say earlier?
en: What did I just say earlier?
ja: さっき何て言ったばかりだったかしら?

key: You're just trying to hide your own emotional standpoint behind a veil of false objectivity.
en: You're just trying to hide your own emotional standpoint behind a veil of false objectivity.
ja: 偽りの客観性のベールで、自分の感情的な立場を隠そうとしてるだけでしょう。

key: Like always.
en: Like always.
ja: いつものように。

key: If you're scared, then admit you're scared.
en: If you're scared, then admit you're scared.
ja: 怖いなら、怖いって認めなさい。

key: Don't try to push that fear onto us.
en: Don't try to push that fear onto us.
ja: その恐怖をわたしたちに押しつけないで。

key: So we're going to go help them, right?
en: So we're going to go help them, right?
ja: だから、みんなを助けに行くのよね?

key: TITANIA: Obviously.
en: TITANIA: Obviously.
ja: ティタニア: 当然でしょう。

key: But I'll never hear the end of it if I don't bring this one along.
en: But I'll never hear the end of it if I don't bring this one along.
ja: でも、こいつを連れて行かなかったら、いつまでも文句を言われそうね。

key: SHELLY: He's been sound asleep for so long...
en: SHELLY: He's been sound asleep for so long...
ja: シェリー: ずいぶん長い間ぐっすり寝てて……

key: TITANIA: If it were any less of a stupid pun, I'd say he sleeps like a rock.
en: TITANIA: If it were any less of a stupid pun, I'd say he sleeps like a rock.
ja: ティタニア: これがもう少しマシな駄しゃれだったら、「岩みたいにぐっすり」とでも言うところね。

key: Oi.
en: Oi.
ja: ちょっと。

key: Titania used Wake-Up Slap!
en: Titania used Wake-Up Slap!
ja: ティタニアのめざましビンタがさく裂した!

key: HARDY: Nn... Not yet...
en: HARDY: Nn... Not yet...
ja: ハーディ: んん……まだだ……

key: I still have to defeat the giant metal Lugia...
en: I still have to defeat the giant metal Lugia...
ja: 巨大な金属のルギアを倒さなきゃ……

key: TITANIA: Your city's awake, numbskull. Time for you to be too.
en: TITANIA: Your city's awake, numbskull. Time for you to be too.
ja: ティタニア: あなたの街は目を覚ましたわよ、この間抜け。あなたもそろそろ起きる時間よ。

key: HARDY: Hey, hey-- Sis, come on-- that's enough.
en: HARDY: Hey, hey-- Sis, come on-- that's enough.
ja: ハーディ: おい、おい――姉貴、勘弁してくれよ――もう十分だって。

key: TITANIA: Did you hear what I just said?
en: TITANIA: Did you hear what I just said?
ja: ティタニア: 今言ったこと、聞こえてた?

key: HARDY: Yea, yea, you said my--
en: HARDY: Yea, yea, you said my--
ja: ハーディ: ああ、ああ、俺の……

key: Wait, what?
en: Wait, what?
ja: って、待て、何だって?

key: TITANIA: And it's under attack by Team Meteor.
en: TITANIA: And it's under attack by Team Meteor.
ja: ティタニア: それに、チームメテオに攻撃されてるわ。

key: HARDY: WAIT, WHAT?!
en: HARDY: WAIT, WHAT?!
ja: ハーディ: 待て、なんだって?!

key: TITANIA: Yeah, you're welcome.
en: TITANIA: Yeah, you're welcome.
ja: ティタニア: ええ、どういたしまして。

key: TITANIA: All right, let's go.
en: TITANIA: All right, let's go.
ja: ティタニア: よし、行くわよ。

key: You too, Rini.
en: You too, Rini.
ja: リニ、あなたもね。

key: Girly, you in?
en: Girly, you in?
ja: お嬢さん、あなたは来る?

key: SHELLY: Y-yeah!
en: SHELLY: Y-yeah!
ja: シェリー: は、はい!

key: TITANIA: Lead on.
en: TITANIA: Lead on.
ja: ティタニア: 先導して。

key: FLORINIA: Understood.
en: FLORINIA: Understood.
ja: フロリニア: 了解。

key: FLORINIA: \PN, your assistance will be appreciated as well.
en: FLORINIA: \PN, your assistance will be appreciated as well.
ja: フロリニア: \PN、あなたの協力もありがたく思います。

key: SAPHIRA: Stay out of this.
en: SAPHIRA: Stay out of this.
ja: サファイラ: これには関わらないで。

key: Just... stay away.
en: Just... stay away.
ja: ただ……離れてて。

key: Clearly I'M the crazy one here for trying to protect my family.
en: Clearly I'M the crazy one here for trying to protect my family.
ja: 家族を守ろうとしてるわたしのほうが、どうやらおかしいみたいだから。

key: LAURA: Saphira, please........
en: LAURA: Saphira, please........
ja: ローラ: サファイラ、お願い……

key: Can you calm down?
en: Can you calm down?
ja: 落ち着いてくれる?

key: It is just us.
en: It is just us.
ja: わたしたちだけなんだから。

key: We've always been here for you, right?
en: We've always been here for you, right?
ja: いつだって、あなたのそばにいたでしょう?

key: LAURA: People only do things because they have reasons.
en: LAURA: People only do things because they have reasons.
ja: ローラ: 人が何かをするのには、理由があるものよ。

key: Even if those things are wrong, or seem very strange to others........
en: Even if those things are wrong, or seem very strange to others........
ja: たとえそれが間違っていても、他人には奇妙に見えても……

key: Isn't it important to understand why someone does something rather than passing judgment right away?
en: Isn't it important to understand why someone does something rather than passing judgment right away?
ja: すぐに裁くより、なぜそうしたのかを理解することのほうが、大事なんじゃないかしら?

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, hi. Great timing.
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, hi. Great timing.
ja: シャルロット: あ、どうも。いいタイミング。

key: Welcome to the civil war.
en: Welcome to the civil war.
ja: 内戦へようこそ。

key: SAPHIRA: This isn't a "war."
en: SAPHIRA: This isn't a "war."
ja: サファイラ: これは「戦争」なんかじゃない。

key: I shouldn't have to fight to keep the ONLY allies I've had on my side.
en: I shouldn't have to fight to keep the ONLY allies I've had on my side.
ja: 唯一の味方をこちら側に留めておくために、戦わなきゃいけないなんておかしいでしょう。

key: It's just a betrayal.
en: It's just a betrayal.
ja: これはただの裏切りよ。

key: LAURA: I'm betraying you by saying someone should get a second chance........?
en: LAURA: I'm betraying you by saying someone should get a second chance........?
ja: ローラ: 誰かにもう一度チャンスを与えるべきだって言うことが、裏切りになるの……?

key: SAPHIRA: He doesn't DESERVE a second chance!
en: SAPHIRA: He doesn't DESERVE a second chance!
ja: サファイラ: あの男に、二度目のチャンスなんて値しない!

key: He's had a lifetime full of chances,
en: He's had a lifetime full of chances,
ja: 一生分のチャンスをもう与えられてきたのに、

key: And YOU know better than anyone what he's done with them.
en: And YOU know better than anyone what he's done with them.
ja: それをどう使ったか、あなたが誰よりもよく知ってるでしょう。

key: LAURA: A lifetime? He's barely older than I am........
en: LAURA: A lifetime? He's barely older than I am........
ja: ローラ: 一生分? あの人、わたしとほとんど歳が変わらないのに……

key: SAPHIRA: What?
en: SAPHIRA: What?
ja: サファイラ: 何ですって?

key: No, I don't care about that boy.
en: No, I don't care about that boy.
ja: いえ、あの少年のことなんてどうでもいい。

key: Do whatever you like with him; I'm over it.
en: Do whatever you like with him; I'm over it.
ja: 好きにすればいいわ、もう気にしてないから。

key: CHARLOTTE: Really?
en: CHARLOTTE: Really?
ja: シャルロット: 本当に?

key: Cuz you sure don't seem over it.
en: Cuz you sure don't seem over it.
ja: 全然気にしてなさそうには見えないけど。

key: SAPHIRA: I'm not talking about him.
en: SAPHIRA: I'm not talking about him.
ja: サファイラ: あいつの話をしてるんじゃないの。

key: Who started all of this?
en: Who started all of this?
ja: そもそも、これを始めたのは誰?

key: CHARLOTTE: Me.
en: CHARLOTTE: Me.
ja: シャルロット: わたし。

key: LAURA: No one blames you for what happened........
en: LAURA: No one blames you for what happened........
ja: ローラ: あの時のこと、誰もあなたを責めてなんかいないわ……

key: CHARLOTTE: I do.
en: CHARLOTTE: I do.
ja: シャルロット: わたしは責めてる。

key: SAPHIRA: I won't allow anyone to talk about you like that.
en: SAPHIRA: I won't allow anyone to talk about you like that.
ja: サファイラ: あなたのことをそんな風に言わせるつもりはないわ。

key: Not even you.
en: Not even you.
ja: あなた自身であっても。

key: CHARLOTTE: Glad to know I have rights.
en: CHARLOTTE: Glad to know I have rights.
ja: シャルロット: 自分にも権利があるって分かってうれしいわ。

key: LAURA: But is that not the same way of thinking?
en: LAURA: But is that not the same way of thinking?
ja: ローラ: でも、それって同じ考え方じゃない?

key: What happened was an accident........
en: What happened was an accident........
ja: あの時のことは、事故だったのよ……

key: Do we really need to keep reminding her of what happened?
en: Do we really need to keep reminding her of what happened?
ja: 何度もあの時のことを思い出させる必要、本当にあるの?

key: CHARLOTTE: Never forgot, but thanks.
en: CHARLOTTE: Never forgot, but thanks.
ja: シャルロット: 忘れたことなんてないけど、ありがと。

key: SAPHIRA: That's different. She was a kid.
en: SAPHIRA: That's different. She was a kid.
ja: サファイラ: それとこれは違うわ。あの子は子供だった。

key: She didn't know what was happening.
en: She didn't know what was happening.
ja: 何が起きてるかも分かってなかった。

key: But the doctor is an adult.
en: But the doctor is an adult.
ja: でも、あの医者は大人でしょう。

key: Even if he doesn't act like it-- and as an adult he made himself responsible for all of our well-beings.
en: Even if he doesn't act like it-- and as an adult he made himself responsible for all of our well-beings.
ja: そういう振る舞いをしていなくても――そして大人として、わたしたち全員の幸福に責任を負うと自ら決めたのよ。

key: And you KNOW how he failed to deliver on that.
en: And you KNOW how he failed to deliver on that.
ja: それをどれだけ果たせなかったか、あなたもよく知ってるはずでしょう。

key: I can't fathom why you're suddenly pretending he's innocent.
en: I can't fathom why you're suddenly pretending he's innocent.
ja: なぜ急に、あの男が無実だったみたいなふりをするのか、わたしには理解できない。

key: Did you forget everything that happened?!
en: Did you forget everything that happened?!
ja: 起きたこと全部、忘れたっていうの?!

key: What I told you--
en: What I told you--
ja: あなたに話したこと――

key: LAURA: I couldn't possibly forget that........
en: LAURA: I couldn't possibly forget that........
ja: ローラ: あれを忘れるなんて、あり得ないわ……

key: SAPHIRA: Sometimes I wonder.
en: SAPHIRA: Sometimes I wonder.
ja: サファイラ: 時々、そうなのかと思うことがあるの。

key: Sometimes I wonder if we're even talking about the same thing.
en: Sometimes I wonder if we're even talking about the same thing.
ja: わたしたち、本当に同じことについて話してるのかしらって、時々思う。

key: Maybe I was the "lucky" one.
en: Maybe I was the "lucky" one.
ja: もしかしたら、わたしのほうが「運が良かった」側だったのかもしれない。

key: Maybe I succeeded in protecting you.
en: Maybe I succeeded in protecting you.
ja: もしかしたら、あなたを守れていたのかもしれない。

key: Or maybe not.
en: Or maybe not.
ja: それとも、守れていなかったのかも。

key: How could I know?
en: How could I know?
ja: どうして分かるっていうの?

key: As much time as I spent in the Circuit or separated from you, I can't be sure--
en: As much time as I spent in the Circuit or separated from you, I can't be sure--
ja: サーキットの中で過ごした時間や、あなたと離れていた時間を思うと、確信なんて持てない――

key: And that's to say nothing of the other kids--
en: And that's to say nothing of the other kids--
ja: それに、他の子供たちのことだって、まだ何も言ってない――

key: I was always thinking--
en: I was always thinking--
ja: ずっと考えてた――

key: You show signs of it too--
en: You show signs of it too--
ja: あなたにも、その兆候はある――

key: It could be either of you--
en: It could be either of you--
ja: どっちにでも、起こり得ることだった――

key: Maybe you just blocked it out.
en: Maybe you just blocked it out.
ja: もしかしたら、ただ記憶を閉ざしただけかもしれない。

key: He taught us about that, right?
en: He taught us about that, right?
ja: あの人が、そのことを教えてくれたんだよね?

key: LAURA: Saphira, what are you--
en: LAURA: Saphira, what are you--
ja: ローラ: サファイラ、あなた何を――

key: SAPHIRA: I didn't know...
en: SAPHIRA: I didn't know...
ja: サファイラ: 知らなかったの……

key: I was supposed to look out for you...
en: I was supposed to look out for you...
ja: あなたを守るはずだったのに……

key: I didn't know...
en: I didn't know...
ja: 知らなかった……

key: I'm sorry...
en: I'm sorry...
ja: ごめんなさい……

key: I'm sorry, but...
en: I'm sorry, but...
ja: ごめんなさい、でも……

key: There's no way that I'll ever forgive him.
en: There's no way that I'll ever forgive him.
ja: あの人のことは、絶対に許せない。

key: Not for half of a second.
en: Not for half of a second.
ja: 一秒たりとも。

key: Not while he's that kind of person.
en: Not while he's that kind of person.
ja: あんな人間でいる限り、無理。

key: The kind of person that would do that to a child--
en: The kind of person that would do that to a child--
ja: 子供にあんなことをするような人間には――

key: Those people don't just CHANGE.
en: Those people don't just CHANGE.
ja: ああいう人間は、変わったりしない。

key: If those in power are given to abuse, they will continue to abuse until they no longer have that power.
en: If those in power are given to abuse, they will continue to abuse until they no longer have that power.
ja: 力を持つ者が虐待に手を染めるなら、その力を失うまで、虐待をやめたりしない。

key: I can't stand the thought of this happening more and more--
en: I can't stand the thought of this happening more and more--
ja: こんなことが、これ以上何度も起きるなんて耐えられない――

key: Not to you,
en: Not to you,
ja: あなたにも、

key: Not to any of the other kids.
en: Not to any of the other kids.
ja: 他の子供たちにも。

key: So I will personally relieve him of that power.
en: So I will personally relieve him of that power.
ja: だから、わたしが直接、あの人からその力を奪う。

key: I'll relieve him of everything he's had.
en: I'll relieve him of everything he's had.
ja: あの人が持っているもの全部、奪ってやる。

key: I'll make sure he understands the shame I felt.
en: I'll make sure he understands the shame I felt.
ja: わたしが感じた恥を、あの人にも思い知らせてやる。

key: LAURA: I don't think it's impossible for people to change........
en: LAURA: I don't think it's impossible for people to change........
ja: ローラ: 人が変わることが不可能だとは、わたしは思わない………

key: Even then, I do not wish to believe that violence is the only answer we have.
en: Even then, I do not wish to believe that violence is the only answer we have.
ja: それでも、暴力だけが答えだなんて、信じたくない。

key: Is that not just perpetuating the pre-existing cycle?
en: Is that not just perpetuating the pre-existing cycle?
ja: それって、今までの繰り返しを、ただ続けているだけなんじゃない?

key: SAPHIRA: That kind of thinking is what allows it to continue.
en: SAPHIRA: That kind of thinking is what allows it to continue.
ja: サファイラ: そういう考え方こそが、それを続けさせるのよ。

key: That's what gets people like you hurt!
en: That's what gets people like you hurt!
ja: だから、あなたみたいな人が傷つくことになるの!

key: LAURA: Then I would rather be hurt.
en: LAURA: Then I would rather be hurt.
ja: ローラ: それなら、わたしは傷つくほうを選ぶわ。

key: SAPHIRA: Then you're still naive.
en: SAPHIRA: Then you're still naive.
ja: サファイラ: だったら、あなたはまだ甘いのよ。

key: Still just a child...
en: Still just a child...
ja: まだ子供のまま……

key: LAURA: I am grateful for your guidance and protection, but are we not entitled to our own opinions of what is best to do?
en: LAURA: I am grateful for your guidance and protection, but are we not entitled to our own opinions of what is best to do?
ja: ローラ: あなたの導きと守りには感謝してる。でも、何が最善かを自分で考える権利くらい、わたしたちにもあるんじゃない?

key: Charlotte, \PN, and everyone.
en: Charlotte, \PN, and everyone.
ja: シャルロットも、\PNも、みんなにも。

key: CHARLOTTE: Don't go dragging me back into this now.
en: CHARLOTTE: Don't go dragging me back into this now.
ja: シャルロット: 今さらわたしを巻き込まないでよ。

key: LAURA: This dilemma belongs to all of us.
en: LAURA: This dilemma belongs to all of us.
ja: ローラ: このジレンマは、わたしたち全員のものよ。

key: CHARLOTTE: What, \PN too?
en: CHARLOTTE: What, \PN too?
ja: シャルロット: 何、\PNも?

key: LAURA: That isn't quite what I had--
en: LAURA: That isn't quite what I had--
ja: ローラ: そういうつもりで言ったんじゃ――

key: CHARLOTTE: You heard the lady.
en: CHARLOTTE: You heard the lady.
ja: シャルロット: 聞いての通りよ。

key: So what's your take on it?
en: So what's your take on it?
ja: で、あんたはどう思うわけ?

key: Is it fine to use violence as an answer to abuse?
en: Is it fine to use violence as an answer to abuse?
ja: 虐待への答えとして、暴力を使うのはアリだと思う?

key: CHARLOTTE: Jury's spoken. I'm out.
en: CHARLOTTE: Jury's spoken. I'm out.
ja: シャルロット: 陪審の判決は出た。わたしは降りる。

key: CHARLOTTE: Heh, not picking a side is the safe choice, isn't it?
en: CHARLOTTE: Heh, not picking a side is the safe choice, isn't it?
ja: シャルロット: へえ、どっちの味方もしないのが無難な選択ってわけね。

key: But I'd agree with that.
en: But I'd agree with that.
ja: でも、それには賛成かな。

key: I don't really think it's anyone's place to be claiming moral righteousness.
en: I don't really think it's anyone's place to be claiming moral righteousness.
ja: 誰かが道徳的な正しさを主張するようなことじゃないと思うし。

key: We're all just piles of flaws trying to make as few mistakes as we possibly can in our lifetimes.
en: We're all just piles of flaws trying to make as few mistakes as we possibly can in our lifetimes.
ja: みんな欠点だらけで、生きてる間になるべく間違いを少なくしようとしてるだけ。

key: But that's fun, too.
en: But that's fun, too.
ja: でも、それも楽しいものよ。

key: SAPHIRA: I don't need anyone's approval.
en: SAPHIRA: I don't need anyone's approval.
ja: サファイラ: 誰の承認もいらない。

key: In fact, it's better if you both stay out of it.
en: In fact, it's better if you both stay out of it.
ja: むしろ、二人とも関わらないほうがいいわ。

key: I'll take care of everything like I always have.
en: I'll take care of everything like I always have.
ja: いつもみたいに、全部わたしが片づけるから。

key: Including Dr. Sigmund Connal's funeral.
en: Including Dr. Sigmund Connal's funeral.
ja: シグムンド・コナル医師の葬式もね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Drama queen.
en: CHARLOTTE: Drama queen.
ja: シャルロット: 大げさなんだから。

key: She thinks saying something intense and then leaving immediately is cool or edgy or something.
en: She thinks saying something intense and then leaving immediately is cool or edgy or something.
ja: 強烈なこと言ってすぐ立ち去るのがクールとかエッジィだとか思ってるのよ。

key: She might be right, but she's still a drama queen.
en: She might be right, but she's still a drama queen.
ja: 正しいのかもしれないけど、大げさなことに変わりはないわ。

key: CHARLOTTE: Dramatic exits are probably better than only answering yes/no questions though.
en: CHARLOTTE: Dramatic exits are probably better than only answering yes/no questions though.
ja: シャルロット: とはいえ、劇的な退場のほうが、イエスかノーでしか答えないよりはマシかもね。

key: You seem like a charming young lady.
en: You seem like a charming young lady.
ja: あなたは、魅力的なお嬢さんのようですね。

key: In fact, you remind me a bit of my daughter.
en: In fact, you remind me a bit of my daughter.
ja: 実を言うと、少し娘を思い出します。

key: Beautiful girl, she was...
en: Beautiful girl, she was...
ja: 美しい娘でした……

key: But after I fell ill, she left to go find a way to cure me.
en: But after I fell ill, she left to go find a way to cure me.
ja: でも、わしが病に倒れてから、わしを治す方法を探しに出て行ってしまいましてね。

key: She always was kind-hearted, if naive.
en: She always was kind-hearted, if naive.
ja: 昔から優しい子でしたよ、少し世間知らずではありましたが。

key: You seem like a spirited young fellow.
en: You seem like a spirited young fellow.
ja: あなたは、元気の良い若者のようですね。

key: You seem like a nice young lad. You remind me of myself when I was younger!
en: You seem like a nice young lad. You remind me of myself when I was younger!
ja: あなたは、感じの良い若者のようですね。若い頃の自分を思い出しますよ!

key: Those were the days, but I'm old and sick now.
en: Those were the days, but I'm old and sick now.
ja: あの頃は良かった。でも、今のわしは年老いて、病気の身です。

key: All I can do is stay here and pray for my daughter's safe return.
en: All I can do is stay here and pray for my daughter's safe return.
ja: わしにできるのは、ここに留まって、娘の無事な帰りを祈ることだけです。

key: She disappeared to find a way to cure me, the noble heart she was.
en: She disappeared to find a way to cure me, the noble heart she was.
ja: わしを治す方法を探しに、姿を消してしまいましてね、本当に気高い子でした。

key: But even I knew that was folly.
en: But even I knew that was folly.
ja: でも、わしでさえ、それが無謀だと分かっていました。

key: There's no cure, I told her.
en: There's no cure, I told her.
ja: 治す方法なんてないと、娘には言ったのです。

key: She even believed me.
en: She even believed me.
ja: 娘もそれを信じてくれました。

key: But she insists that if she works with this group, they would find a way.
en: But she insists that if she works with this group, they would find a way.
ja: でも、あるグループと一緒にやれば、何か方法が見つかるはずだと言い張って。

key: Is there really a group that has such a power?
en: Is there really a group that has such a power?
ja: 本当に、そんな力を持つグループがあるのでしょうか?

key: I'm proud of her, but worried.
en: I'm proud of her, but worried.
ja: 娘を誇りに思う一方で、心配でなりません。

key: Hopefully she'll come back to me soon, not for my sake, but for hers.
en: Hopefully she'll come back to me soon, not for my sake, but for hers.
ja: わしのためではなく、娘自身のために、早く帰ってきてほしいものです。

key: You met a girl named Eclipse? That's-- Caitlyn!
en: You met a girl named Eclipse? That's-- Caitlyn!
ja: エクリプスという名の娘に会った? それは――ケイトリンだ!

key: Oh, how wonderful!
en: Oh, how wonderful!
ja: ああ、なんと素晴らしい!

key: Do tell, is she doing well?
en: Do tell, is she doing well?
ja: 教えてください、あの子は元気にしていますか?

key: I'm sure she's doing famously.
en: I'm sure she's doing famously.
ja: きっと、大活躍しているんでしょう。

key: I'm sorry?
en: I'm sorry?
ja: ……もう一度、なんと?

key: You're saying she's... dead?
en: You're saying she's... dead?
ja: あの子が……死んだ、と言うのですか?

key: That's ridiculous.
en: That's ridiculous.
ja: 馬鹿げている。

key: You've probably never even met her for real.
en: You've probably never even met her for real.
ja: あなたは、本当は娘に会ったことすらないのでしょう。

key: There's no need for a liar in this house. Be gone!
en: There's no need for a liar in this house. Be gone!
ja: この家に、うそつきなど必要ない。出て行ってくれ!

key: There's no way Caitlyn would be dead, you scoundrel!
en: There's no way Caitlyn would be dead, you scoundrel!
ja: ケイトリンが死ぬはずなどない、この悪党め!

key: Play your pranks elsewhere!
en: Play your pranks elsewhere!
ja: 悪ふざけなら、よそでやってくれ!

key: If only I had been stronger, or stopped her, maybe this wouldn't have happened.
en: If only I had been stronger, or stopped her, maybe this wouldn't have happened.
ja: わしがもっと強ければ、娘を止めていれば、こんなことにはならなかったのかもしれない。

key: Maybe if I had been closer, or talked more.
en: Maybe if I had been closer, or talked more.
ja: もっとそばにいれば、もっと話をしていれば。

key: Perhaps if I had prayed.
en: Perhaps if I had prayed.
ja: 祈っていれば、良かったのだろうか。

key: Perhaps if I had wept.
en: Perhaps if I had wept.
ja: 泣いていれば、良かったのだろうか。

key: Perhaps if I hadn't.
en: Perhaps if I hadn't.
ja: 泣かずにいれば、良かったのだろうか。

key: No, too late...
en: No, too late...
ja: いや、もう遅い……

key: Too late...
en: Too late...
ja: もう遅いのだ……

key: To be able to spend our time and passions on frivolous, even empty pursuits...
en: To be able to spend our time and passions on frivolous, even empty pursuits...
ja: たわいもない、いっそ空虚とも言える物事に、時間と情熱を注げるということ……

key: That's a privilege in its own right.
en: That's a privilege in its own right.
ja: それ自体が、一つの特権なのです。

key: But to be able to do it with those for whom we care most?
en: But to be able to do it with those for whom we care most?
ja: でも、それを一番大切な人たちと分かち合えるとしたら?

key: I can think of no greater pursuit.
en: I can think of no greater pursuit.
ja: これ以上の望みは、わしには思いつきません。

key: Ah, also, Trainer--
en: Ah, also, Trainer--
ja: ああ、それと、トレーナーさん――

key: Do you mind, a moment of your time?
en: Do you mind, a moment of your time?
ja: 少し、お時間をいただけますか?

key: I'd wanted to share this as a gift with Caitlyn before, but then--
en: I'd wanted to share this as a gift with Caitlyn before, but then--
ja: 以前、これをケイトリンへの贈り物として渡したいと思っていたのですが――

key: ...No, I mustn't think about that now.
en: ...No, I mustn't think about that now.
ja: ……いや、今それを考えるのはやめましょう。

key: She had told me it was all thanks to you.
en: She had told me it was all thanks to you.
ja: 娘は、すべてあなたのおかげだと言っていました。

key: There is little I can do to repay you, but--
en: There is little I can do to repay you, but--
ja: わしにできるお返しなど、ほとんどありませんが――

key: The next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "shinycharm".
en: The next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "shinycharm".
ja: 今度、誰かにパスワードを聞かれたら、「shinycharm」と伝えてください。

key: Perhaps then your early days can shine as brightly as mine do now.
en: Perhaps then your early days can shine as brightly as mine do now.
ja: そうすれば、あなたのこれからの日々も、今のわしのように輝いて見えるかもしれません。

key: Bzz, bzbzbzz bzzt...
en: Bzz, bzbzbzz bzzt...
ja: ブブ、ブブブブ ブブッ……

key: ELEKID: Bzzt...
en: ELEKID: Bzzt...
ja: エレキッド: ブブッ……

key: Do you want to take Elekid with you?
en: Do you want to take Elekid with you?
ja: エレキッドを迎え入れますか?

key: One of the stupid Team Meteor's attacks hit just close enough to my place that it knocked out part of my generator.
en: One of the stupid Team Meteor's attacks hit just close enough to my place that it knocked out part of my generator.
ja: バカなチームメテオの攻撃が、うちのすぐ近くに当たって、発電機の一部がイカれちまったんだよ。

key: No way I'm going to use public electricity!
en: No way I'm going to use public electricity!
ja: 公共電力なんて絶対使ってやるもんか!

key: It makes the utilities way too expensive!
en: It makes the utilities way too expensive!
ja: 光熱費がめちゃくちゃ高くつくんだ!

key: Until I can find some way to fix it, I'll just use my Elekid!
en: Until I can find some way to fix it, I'll just use my Elekid!
ja: 直す方法が見つかるまでは、うちのエレキッドを使うことにしたのさ!

key: Easy, cheap solution, right? I'm a genius!
en: Easy, cheap solution, right? I'm a genius!
ja: 簡単で安上がりな解決策だろ? 俺って天才!

key: Stupid thing keeps grumbling at me though. And how?
en: Stupid thing keeps grumbling at me though. And how?
ja: でもこいつ、ずっとブツブツ文句言ってきやがる。だいたいどうしてだよ?

key: You're an Electric-type, shut up and do your thing already!
en: You're an Electric-type, shut up and do your thing already!
ja: お前はでんきタイプなんだから、黙って仕事しろっての!

key: Hm... But I see you've got an Electirizer there.
en: Hm... But I see you've got an Electirizer there.
ja: ん……でも、そっちエレキブースター持ってるみたいだな。

key: I think something like that would do just fine for my generator, and probably be a whole lot quieter.
en: I think something like that would do just fine for my generator, and probably be a whole lot quieter.
ja: それがあれば、うちの発電機にもぴったりだと思うし、たぶんもっと静かになるはずだ。

key: What do you think? Wanna give it to me?
en: What do you think? Wanna give it to me?
ja: どうだ? 俺にくれる気ない?

key: \PN handed over the Electirizer.
en: \PN handed over the Electirizer.
ja: \PNはエレキブースターを渡した。

key: Finally! Now this stupid Elekid can stop complaining!
en: Finally! Now this stupid Elekid can stop complaining!
ja: ついに! これでこのバカなエレキッドも、文句を言わずに済むな!

key: I should just get rid of it, huh?
en: I should just get rid of it, huh?
ja: もう手放しちまえばいいのかもな?

key: That'll solve the noise problem for sure.
en: That'll solve the noise problem for sure.
ja: そうすりゃ、うるさい問題も確実に解決だ。

key: Trainer, get that thing out of my sight.
en: Trainer, get that thing out of my sight.
ja: トレーナー、そいつを俺の目の前から連れて行ってくれ。

key: Oh well, looks like Elekid will just have to take that work on itself.
en: Oh well, looks like Elekid will just have to take that work on itself.
ja: ま、いいか。エレキッドには、自分でその仕事をやってもらうしかなさそうだ。

key: Just do it quietly!
en: Just do it quietly!
ja: とにかく静かにやれよ!

key: Technology is much better than stupid Pokémon anyway!
en: Technology is much better than stupid Pokémon anyway!
ja: どうせ、くだらないポケモンより機械のほうがずっとマシなんだよ!

key: TEACHER: If everyone would please turn to page seventy-four-- Oh, sorry, can we help you?
en: TEACHER: If everyone would please turn to page seventy-four-- Oh, sorry, can we help you?
ja: 先生: では皆さん、74ページを開いて――あら、ごめんなさい、何かご用ですか?

key: Otherwise, I'm trying to keep everyone focused.
en: Otherwise, I'm trying to keep everyone focused.
ja: そうでないなら、今はみんなの集中を保とうとしているところなので。

key: It's hard enough to stay on task normally, let alone when our heating goes out.
en: It's hard enough to stay on task normally, let alone when our heating goes out.
ja: 普段でも集中させるのは大変なのに、暖房が止まってしまうとなおさらで。

key: These kids get cold and then start going to sleep, or even worse, rough-housing to keep themselves warm.
en: These kids get cold and then start going to sleep, or even worse, rough-housing to keep themselves warm.
ja: 子供たちは寒くなると眠くなってしまうし、もっとひどいと、暖まろうとして騒ぎ出すんです。

key: But one of Team Meteor's attacks managed to knock out our heater.
en: But one of Team Meteor's attacks managed to knock out our heater.
ja: でも、チームメテオの攻撃のひとつで、うちの暖房がやられてしまって。

key: Our Magby is trying its best, but it's not really the same, you know?
en: Our Magby is trying its best, but it's not really the same, you know?
ja: うちのブビィが頑張ってくれてはいるんですけど、やっぱり同じというわけにはいかなくて。

key: TEACHER: Um, sorry to ask, is that a Magmarizer you have there?
en: TEACHER: Um, sorry to ask, is that a Magmarizer you have there?
ja: 先生: あの、聞いてもいいですか、それってマグマブースターですか?

key: That could be useful.
en: That could be useful.
ja: それなら、役に立ちそうです。

key: In fact, I bet we could use it to fix our heater!
en: In fact, I bet we could use it to fix our heater!
ja: それがあれば、暖房を直せるかもしれません!

key: Would you maybe be willing to part with it?
en: Would you maybe be willing to part with it?
ja: もしよければ、それを譲っていただけませんか?

key: \PN handed over the Magmarizer.
en: \PN handed over the Magmarizer.
ja: \PNはマグマブースターを渡した。

key: TEACHER: Great work, Magby, thank you so much!
en: TEACHER: Great work, Magby, thank you so much!
ja: 先生: よくやったわね、ブビィ、本当にありがとう!

key: Hm? Why are you so riled up, Magby?
en: Hm? Why are you so riled up, Magby?
ja: あら? どうしてそんなに興奮してるの、ブビィ?

key: MAGBY: Maaaaag!
en: MAGBY: Maaaaag!
ja: ブビィ: ブビィィ!

key: TEACHER: Could it be that you want to go with this Trainer?
en: TEACHER: Could it be that you want to go with this Trainer?
ja: 先生: もしかして、このトレーナーさんについて行きたいの?

key: TEACHER: I see...
en: TEACHER: I see...
ja: 先生: そう……

key: Well, if that's what you want, I won't stop you.
en: Well, if that's what you want, I won't stop you.
ja: それがあなたの望みなら、止めはしないわ。

key: TEACHER: Sorry! That was presumptuous of me to ask. I totally understand.
en: TEACHER: Sorry! That was presumptuous of me to ask. I totally understand.
ja: 先生: ごめんなさい! こちらから聞くなんて、出過ぎたことでした。ちゃんと分かっていますから。

key: TEACHER: At any rate, please remain diligent, students!
en: TEACHER: At any rate, please remain diligent, students!
ja: 先生: とにかく、みなさんは真面目に勉強を続けてくださいね!

key: It's still really cold.
en: It's still really cold.
ja: まだ、すごく寒いね。

key: Now this is more like it!
en: Now this is more like it!
ja: これでこそって感じ!

key: So bored... and I'm getting sleepy too.
en: So bored... and I'm getting sleepy too.
ja: つまんない……それに、眠くなってきた。

key: You'd still let me play with Magby sometime, right?
en: You'd still let me play with Magby sometime, right?
ja: また今度、ブビィと遊ばせてくれるよね?

key: Our teacher is really nice, but she doesn't always think practically.
en: Our teacher is really nice, but she doesn't always think practically.
ja: うちの先生、すごくいい人なんだけど、あんまり実際的なことは考えてないんだよね。

key: Maaaag...
en: Maaaag...
ja: ブビィ……

key: MAG: Mag, Magby!
en: MAG: Mag, Magby!
ja: ブビィ: ブビ、ブビィ!

key: Do you want to take Magby with you?
en: Do you want to take Magby with you?
ja: ブビィを迎え入れますか?

key: "LCCC-C Entrance Unlocked."
en: "LCCC-C Entrance Unlocked."
ja: 「LCCC-Cの入り口が解錠された。」

key: FATHER: Oh, come in, Trainer...
en: FATHER: Oh, come in, Trainer...
ja: 父親: おお、お入りください、トレーナーさん……

key: FATHER: Or should I say, Champion?
en: FATHER: Or should I say, Champion?
ja: 父親: いや、チャンピオンと呼ぶべきかな?

key: ECLIPSE: Oh.
en: ECLIPSE: Oh.
ja: エクリプス: あ。

key: Uh, hey, \PN.
en: Uh, hey, \PN.
ja: えっと、よ、\PN。

key: Didn't really expect you to drop by already...
en: Didn't really expect you to drop by already...
ja: もうここに来るなんて、正直思ってなかった……

key: FATHER: Caitlyn has told me everything.
en: FATHER: Caitlyn has told me everything.
ja: 父親: ケイトリンから、すべて聞きました。

key: About how you and your friends saved her...
en: About how you and your friends saved her...
ja: あなたとお仲間が、あの子を救ってくださったこと……

key: Pulled her right back into this world somehow!
en: Pulled her right back into this world somehow!
ja: どうにかして、この世界に引き戻してくれたのですね!

key: Imagine that!
en: Imagine that!
ja: 驚いたものです!

key: It's all too supernatural for me.
en: It's all too supernatural for me.
ja: わしには、あまりにも超自然的な話で。

key: I'm dearly sorry for how I acted to you before, Champion.
en: I'm dearly sorry for how I acted to you before, Champion.
ja: 以前のわしの態度については、心よりおわび申し上げます、チャンピオン。

key: But I'm just glad to have my little girl back.
en: But I'm just glad to have my little girl back.
ja: でも、娘が戻ってきてくれただけで、本当にうれしいのです。

key: Though, gave me a right fright, it did!
en: Though, gave me a right fright, it did!
ja: とはいえ、あの時は本当に肝を冷やしましたよ!

key: Wandered upstairs to check on her as I do,
en: Wandered upstairs to check on her as I do,
ja: いつものように様子を見に二階へ上がったら、

key: Suddenly, no little girl in bed!
en: Suddenly, no little girl in bed!
ja: 急に、ベッドに娘の姿がなくて!

key: Where could she have gone?!
en: Where could she have gone?!
ja: 一体どこへ行ったんだと!

key: I thought I'd have a heart attack and perish on the spot!
en: I thought I'd have a heart attack and perish on the spot!
ja: その場で心臓発作を起こして死ぬかと思いましたよ!

key: ECLIPSE: Dad.
en: ECLIPSE: Dad.
ja: エクリプス: パパ。

key: FATHER: Yes, yes, I know...
en: FATHER: Yes, yes, I know...
ja: 父親: ああ、ああ、分かってる……

key: ECLIPSE: He's told this same story to like six other people already.
en: ECLIPSE: He's told this same story to like six other people already.
ja: エクリプス: パパ、もうこの話、他に6人くらいにしてるから。

key: FATHER: And then she just up and walks in through the door!
en: FATHER: And then she just up and walks in through the door!
ja: 父親: それで、あの子はふらっとドアから入ってきたんですよ!

key: Just like that!
en: Just like that!
ja: それはもう、あっさりと!

ja: エクリプス: ああ、ちょっとその辺は本人に処理させてあげて。
